description: Country names covered by the global sponsoring/office directory that find_market_mentions() would otherwise miss - either because the market has no widget deployment and so no entry in markets.json at all (e.g. Japan), or because the directory spells an already-configured market's name differently than markets.json does (e.g. 'Tanzania' vs markets.json's 'Tanzania, United Republic of'). This never changes which country's policy documents a session can access - that stays governed entirely by markets.json/policy_locales.json - it only widens what find_market_mentions() recognizes as a named market for global-directory query planning and the cross-market evidence gate. Deliberately excludes regional groupings the directory lists as a single record covering multiple countries (Central America, North America, Scandinavia, Kenya/East Africa) and constituent countries of an already-configured market (England, Scotland are part of the existing United Kingdom (GB) market) - both need a content-team decision on the right mapping, not a guess.
